notes.title: Update 12 Online Survival
notes.content:
Added online mode to survival.
Added a new filter red blue.

Fixes:
Fixed a memory leak when recieving packets online.
Fixed death pixel packet not being sent online.
Fixed puppet facing wrong direction online.
Fixed projectiles not being displayed when a puppet bullet or shotgun bullet is on screen when online.
Fixed shuriken being drawn as a card online.
Fixed a memory leak when using the baller.

notes.title: Update 11
notes.content:
Problem causing game to not launch should be fixed.
Online on the mac version might not be working. We will try to fix it.

Changes:
Made it so that when the shooter shoots within smoke the bullets give more damage and are different color.
Ninja can pick up shuriken to refill stamina.
Improved punching puppets attack hit boxes.
Owl gets stunned if their knife gets hit.
Decreased Trickster attack speed.
Removed send type option for online multiplayer.

Fixes:
Fixed bug where pixel effects on item pickup were small.
Fixed some of the achievements not being given.
Fixed bomber throwing bombs in to walls.
Fixed bomber costume drawing positions.
Improved ai path finding.
Fixed joystick always pressing up.
Fixed arcade 2 playing same song over and over.
Fixed poison death animation online bug.
Fixed poison win animation online bug.
Fixed survival results screen showing wrong highscore.

notes.title: Update 10
notes.content:
Fixed the final boss in arcade 1 being the wrong boss.
Fixed problem with the game not saving Poison costume or beating arcade.
Fixed up how the poison gas gives damage. The poison will now give the correct amount of damage to bosses.
Fixed bug where Clawer could go into the wall at the start of a fight.
Fixed game being drawn wrong sizes when using filters on mac.
Fixed shooter not going invisible when in smoke.

Added a slowing effect to the poison gas to make it a little better.

For next update:
There is a problem with some of the achievements so I will fix those.
I will try to get online survival mode done.

notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
Added a way to reset controls if they get all messed up.
Press shift + enter to reset controls to default and go to the main menu.

Press tab to switch draw setting. This will probably be moved to the options in the next update. The second draw setting wont keep the aspect ratio and it might make the game run faster if it is running slow.

Increased shotgun single shot strength when colliding with other projectiles.
Increased owl maximum special stamina.
Increased owl special stamina cost.
Shortened delay when bomber throws bombs.
Slightly increased delay when robot shoots a rocket.
Shortened delay of necromancer normal shot.

notes.title: Update 7
notes.content:
If the game wont start or you can't go to online mode after the update:
right click the game and delete local content then reinstall the game.

Fixed bomber idle graphic.
Made it so that the host will wait if someone is lagging online.
Fixed up the options menu.
Added sfx volume control.
Added setting to turn off hud bars and draw game taller.
Added option to turn off double tap dash.
Fixed bug where choosing random in online would crash game.
Fixed online character select display on higher res screens.
Added shift to list of keys.
Added dash button for keyboard controls.
Made it so necromancer skeletons will constantly lose health.
Fixed bug where pressing enter on sendtype option would crash game.
Made it so Fighters very slowly heal.
Made it so bee honey shots give a little damage.
Increased damage of archers weak shots.
Maybe fixed sound bug with noonja boss.
Added more controller support. In the options in gameplay choose joystick.
Only tested it with a ps4 controller.

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
Fixed bug where removing certain players in squad mode characterselect screen caused game to crash.
Fixed bug where deleting an ai in squad mode characterselect screen caused another players squad to change.
Fixed bug where arcade mode couldn't be played if squad mode was selected in versus.
Fixed water bubble going small when attacking.
Fixed most of characters drawing wrong frames when rolling in the air.
Fixed robot being able to shoot infinite rockets while dashing.
Fixed fire being able to create infinite fireballs when dashing.
Fixed melee fighters being able to continuously attack while dashing in the air.
Fixed dash stamina not going down if dashing fast enough causing fighters to be able to dash forever.
Made bunny hitbox smaller.
Made bunny portals disappear if not used.
Fixed bug where the steam overlay would still show on the screen if the resolution didn't match the window.
Made it so landing on another fighter doesn't stop air attacks.
Fixed bug that caused game to crash when a robot beam hit a fighter with sheild power up.
Made it so the same song doesn't play over and over in survival mode.
Fixed knight being drawn wrong if blocking while attacking in the air.
Fixed up stamina loss on clashes.
Fixed ninja shurikens being drawn to high when thrown down
Fixed bug that caused lancer air special to use too much stamina.
Fixed bug that caused knight special to use too much stamina.
Added a delay before swordsman boss teleports after getting hit.
Fixed bug where some projectiles would kill stunned bosses in one hit.
Fixed clawer memory leak when using the costume.
Made vs screen skippable.
Fixed bomber drawing wrong frames when rolling or walljumping.
Fixed ninja being drawn wrong if throwing shuriken while attacking in air.
Fixed noonja being drawn wrong if using special while attacking in air.
Fixed owl being drawn wrong if using special while attacking in air.
Made it harder to teleport into a wall with owl.
Fixed bug where wizards full body fire attack would continue even if blocked.
